text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for all your hard work during 
training today, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
The U.A.F. management staff just finished 
performing maintenance on the equipment 
used for the competition training.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
I believe this will allow for more 
fulfilling training, so please make good 
use of it.
